_comment: Starter catalogue for a fresh production instance. Copy, replace with real listings, and
point CATALOG_SEED_MANIFEST at the copy (mount it into the server container).
CatalogSeeder creates these on boot under the ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL account and skips any
whose `name` already exists under it, so a re-run fills gaps and overwrites nothing. Edit a
seeded listing in the studio and the manifest stops being the truth for it — by design.
`publish: true` is required for a listing to appear in GET /api/products; createProduct
always writes DRAFT, and a DRAFT is invisible to shoppers. Omit it to stage content and
publish from /designer/products when you are ready.
`category` must match what the shop filters and the outfit slots look for. The vocabulary
lives in three places that do not fully agree (see finding A-27) — Tops, Bottoms, Dresses,
Outerwear, Shoes, Accessories are the values DataSeeder uses and the catalogue filters match.
`media` are URLs served from the shared asset volume or /uploads; upload the images through
POST /api/designer/products/upload/image first and paste the returned paths here. `glbUrl`
is optional — leaving it out means no 3D preview, and the try-on surface degrades rather
